channel.title: Natural World
channel.desc: In 1970, a picture of a snow monkey bathing in a hot spring graced the cover of `Life' Magazine. Ever since, Japan's hot-tubbing primates have been protected and well fed for the enjoyment of tourists and photographers, they have become international superstars of the natural world. While their unique lifestyle has brought fame, the rest of Japan's snow monkeys lead very different lives.
